access_observation_note: access_utc is the exact UTC clock value captured immediately after each web-open batch returned. It records when the source content had been observed in this session, not a server publication timestamp. Mutable docs are not frozen; pin their live revision before any pilot.

sources.title: PRISMA-S: an extension to the PRISMA Statement for Reporting Literature Searches in Systematic Reviews
sources.version_or_commit: Final journal article, Systematic Reviews 10, 39 (2021), DOI 10.1186/s13643-020-01542-z; publisher version.
sources.observed_operation: Reporting guidance: asks for named sources and exact strategies for each source; purposefully browsed sites and web searches; citation search method/base records; adapted prior strategies; and deduplication software/process.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Applies to systematic-review literature-search reporting and is intended to supplement PRISMA 2020. It does not prescribe a search algorithm or prove that a search is exhaustive. It explicitly recognizes that some web/search-tool results cannot be exactly reproduced later and still asks that the method be declared.
sources.applicability: Use as the pilot’s audit log and disclosure checklist for database queries, repository/site searches, citations, and record deduplication.

sources.title: Cochrane Handbook, Chapter 4: Searching for and selecting studies
sources.version_or_commit: Version 6.5.1; chapter last updated March 2025 (as identified on the chapter page).
sources.locator: Sections 4.3.5, 4.4.11; especially lines 495-501 on iterative search development, inadequately evaluated stopping rules, scarce evidence caution, known-item checks, and citation/reference checking.
sources.observed_operation: Methodological guidance on broad source discovery, grey sources, search-performance checking, and search stopping.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Cochrane-specific conduct guidance. It describes suggestions such as stopping after no new relevant records or low precision but says there has been little formal evaluation; it cautions that scarce evidence requires more careful stopping decisions.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit pilot stop rules, independently chosen known-item checks, and treating citation findings as adequacy evidence rather than a full-corpus denominator.

sources.title: Cochrane Handbook Technical Supplement to Chapter 4
sources.version_or_commit: Handbook version 6.5; technical supplement last updated September 2024 (cover/citation, PDF pp. 0-1).
sources.locator: Contents pp. 5-15 and 25-37 on source classes, including citation indexes, grey-literature sources, handsearching, references, and general web search; PDF pp. 13-15 on grey-literature scope and feasibility; section 4 on managing references.
sources.observed_operation: A source taxonomy and implementation guidance for bibliographic, citation, regional, grey-literature, web, and manual routes; notes diversity/volume and need to tailor grey searches to question and resources.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: There is no single gold-standard rigorous grey-literature search method; sources should be tailored to the question and feasible resources. Google Scholar may locate volume/known items but should not be the only systematic-review resource. Organizational reports may matter for implementation questions.
sources.applicability: Supports separate finite repository/manual arms and a realistic time budget, especially for municipal implementation material.

sources.title: Urban Heat Island Mitigation Strategies: 2021 Update
sources.version_or_commit: Institut national de santé publique du Québec, 2021 Update, Appendix 1, printed pp. 126-128 / PDF pp. 139-141.
sources.locator: Appendix 1, lines 4554-4575 for databases, query concepts, dates, and scientific records; lines 4605-4623 for grey sources, bilingual search, operators, and stopping rule.
sources.observed_operation: Primary public-health institute report describing an implemented literature collection with librarian assistance, six scholarly databases/platforms, free and controlled terms, bilingual grey search through Google/Google Scholar and named government/lab sites, and a relevance-based manual stopping rule.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The work targets measures potentially applicable in Québec; its language, climate, publication-date, inclusion, and chosen-review criteria are specific to that project. 4,487 and 985 duplicate counts describe the scientific-literature stream; the cited passage does not give grey-route yield by portal.
sources.applicability: Close implementation comparator for urban heat. Reuse the disclosure model, not the Québec-specific eligibility or its subjective gray-search stopping rule.

sources.title: OpenAlex API Search — Querying
sources.version_or_commit: Mutable official documentation; no document version or commit displayed. Captured live on access date.
sources.locator: Sections What gets searched and Keywords in search (lines 32-53); phrase/fuzzy/wildcard and relevance/rerank sections (lines 94-159).
sources.observed_operation: Current OpenAlex works-search documentation says search can cover title, abstract, full text, and keywords, with field-scoped variants, phrase/wildcard/fuzzy options, and semantic search; default result order is relevance and citation count contributes to score.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Full text is only available for a subset; keyword matching can retrieve works without the exact text phrase; default relevance is ranked rather than exhaustive, and citation counts affect ordering. Documentation is mutable and API behavior/pricing may change.
sources.applicability: Useful open scholarly discovery and term-expansion comparison arm. Freeze request, date, result pagination, query form, and versioned response; do not treat as a municipal-report denominator.

sources.title: Crossref REST API documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Official mutable API documentation. Page itself says last updated 2020-04-08; it describes the live API, so schema/behavior version must be rechecked before a pilot.
sources.locator: REST API overview and endpoints, lines 112-147; documentation says member-deposited metadata and no sign-up at lines 114-119.
sources.observed_operation: Public REST API to search/filter registered scholarly metadata, with works, DOI, member, and type endpoints; metadata comes from members and trusted sources.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Coverage is conditioned on Crossref registration/deposit and metadata practices. Public API does not imply a complete set of municipal reports. Some abstracts can carry copyright restrictions.
sources.applicability: Supplemental identifier/report-metadata route and cross-source linking, not sole grey-literature search.

sources.title: Crossref REST API filters
sources.version_or_commit: Official documentation page last updated 2025-10-16; current filter reference, not a pinned API schema.
sources.locator: Works filters: approved-date conditions for dissertation, standard, and report at lines 166-180; type/type-name filters at lines 256-265; record date and exact-value filter notes at lines 155-165 and 238-243.
sources.observed_operation: Defines Crossref work filtering by type and registered metadata dates; permits a report-typed search only for items carrying that metadata type.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Type/date filters operate on existing Crossref records and their submitted fields; missing or miscoded report records remain outside the result. Type filtering cannot discover unregistered local documents.
sources.applicability: Use to identify indexed report-like works and test metadata gaps; maintain a separate portal/repository route.

sources.title: Zotero Duplicate Detection
sources.version_or_commit: Mutable main-branch documentation; exact commit was not exposed by browser/API lookup (API lookup returned an internal error). Pin a revision before applying to a pilot.
sources.locator: Finding Duplicates and Merging Duplicates, lines 190-210.
sources.observed_operation: The documented matcher uses title, DOI, and ISBN fields, then publication years within one year and creator-list overlap; matches are confined to one library. Human merge can select master fields; docs say false positives cannot be marked as non-duplicates.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Candidate detection only within one library; distinct group libraries do not cross-match. Documentation describes possible algorithm evolution. Do not treat an algorithm flag or merge as proof of same study.
sources.applicability: Optional candidate-pair generator. Retain raw items, adjudicate versions separately, and avoid destructive auto-merging.

sources.title: ASReview LAB Progress and Results
sources.version_or_commit: Stable documentation page labeled ASReview LAB 3.0.8 in the page title/navigation; implementation version should be pinned to release tag/commit.
sources.locator: Stop screening, lines 58-66; export and label/ranking semantics, lines 85-125.
sources.observed_operation: Optional active-learning screening dashboard; stop threshold measures consecutive irrelevant records since the last relevant one, is not set by default, and reaching it prompts a human to stop or continue. Dataset export preserves labels and unreviewed records/ranking.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Threshold must be chosen by a user and guidance says its ideal value is still researched. It prioritizes screening among retrieved records; it does not expand search coverage or certify recall.
sources.applicability: Only a workload aid after records are discovered; compare against conventional screening and audit unseen records.

sources.title: ASReview release history
sources.version_or_commit: Observed tags/verified short commits: v3.0.5 516290b; v3.0.6 f1d388e; v3.0.7 05b68eb; v3.0.8 d3e863c. Release page shows day/month and verified commit; year is not rendered in the observed section.
sources.locator: v3.0.5 decision migration/project-import/export fixes (lines 360-380); v3.0.6 database lock (296-314); v3.0.7 dropped ranking table (241-260); v3.0.8 corrupted saved ranking record_id (177-195).
sources.observed_operation: Official signed GitHub release history showing concrete fixes to decision migration, import retry behavior, database locking, ranking persistence, and saved ranking record identifiers.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release notes establish what maintainers say changed, not that all failure modes are absent. Pin and test the selected release with a small export/import/reopen and label-retention check.
sources.applicability: Implementation history relevant to screening state and auditability; not evidence of search-source coverage.
